title: Did not seal the bags.
text:
Did not seal the bags.. This Vacuum Sealer is not what I expected. I was so disappointed with the sealer. I used the bags that come with the sealer and sealed some food. It instantly filled with air. I used a different bag, for it to fill with air. I checked the top to see if it had a hole somewhere. The whole top was unsealed, although I had just sealed it.

The box comes with a sealer and an electrical cord. It has 5 different settings: dry, moist, soft, hand vacuum, and seal. It also comes in two different sizes of bags. Instructions are included.

I will not be recommending this Vacuum Sealer to family and friends.
